name: Cypress (Mediterranean)
source_reference: ISO 20839:2017 - Oil of Cupressus sempervirens; Arctander, 'Perfume and Flavor Materials of Natural Origin', 1960; Ferretti et al., Flavour and Fragrance Journal, 2012
notes: Mediterranean cypress oil is valued in fine fragrance for its clean, coniferous character. It differs from blue cypress (Callitris intratropica) which contains guaiazulene. Distillation of needles alone produces a finer oil than whole branches.

key_markers.80-56-8: alpha-Pinene - dominant pine-resinous character, backbone of cypress scent
key_markers.13466-78-9: delta-3-Carene - sweet, piney, distinguishes cypress from juniper
key_markers.77-53-2: Cedrol - woody, cedar-like base note providing longevity and depth

olfactive_description: Fresh, clean, coniferous-resinous with a bright pinaceous top note. Crisp and balsamic with a smoky-woody drydown. Evokes Mediterranean landscapes and evergreen forests.
